name: The Arcana: Vanished from Vesuvia
source:
When Muriel and the MC realize Inanna is missing, they recruit their friends to help in the search. They get more than they bargained for when some unexpected thieves show up in Vesuvia.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当穆里尔和主持人意识到伊南娜失踪后，他们招募朋友来帮助寻找。当一些意想不到的盗贼出现在维苏维亚时，他们得到的比他们预想的要多。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
